name: Najdat Kharijite emirate
alt: Najda's state in Najd and the Yamama

successors.name: Umayyad Caliphate
successors.text: Najd, Bahrain, Oman, Yemen and Ta'if

rulers.name: Najda
rulers.title: leader (declared himself caliph c.687 per the Second Fitna page)

ledger.x: 685: Second Fitna page: Najda 'established an independent state in Najd and Yamama in 685'.
Second Fitna page: Najda 'captured Yemen and Hadhramawt in 688'.
Second Fitna page: Najda 'occupied Ta'if in 689'.
692: Najdat page: Abu Fudayk 'repelled a caliphate attack from Basra' in 692.
693: Najdat page: 'they were eventually defeated by the caliphate in 693, at the battle of Mushahhar'.
693: the war ends with the defeat at Mushahhar.
693: the Najdat state ends with the defeat at Mushahhar; Cliopatria's Umayyad shape of 692 already contains these lands.

wars.name: Najdat revolt
wars.outcome: Umayyad victory: the Najdat were 'eventually defeated by the caliphate in 693, at the battle of Mushahhar' (Najdat page).

certainty.note: Tribal rule over the interior of Arabia; the pages list lands held, not borders, and date Bahrain and Oman nowhere.
